definitions.note: Feminine form of “anão” (male dwarf).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A anã trabalhava no circo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The female dwarf worked in the circus.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O anão contou uma história engraçada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The dwarf told a funny story.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela ganhou dois anéis de prata.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She got two silver rings.

definitions.note: Feminine singular form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela fez uma denúncia anônima.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She made an anonymous report.

definitions.note: Plural of "anão".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: No conto, os anões moram na floresta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: In the story, the dwarfs live in the forest.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vi um anúncio de emprego na internet.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I saw a job ad on the internet.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vi muitos anúncios na internet hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I saw many ads on the internet today.

definitions.note: Common contraction of a + o, used before a masculine singular noun.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vamos ao cinema hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We're going to the movies today.

definitions.note: Contraction of "a" + "o" (used before a masculine singular noun).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou ao mercado depois do trabalho.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I'm going to the market after work.

definitions.note: Used with verbs of movement to mean “to where”; in informal Brazilian Portuguese it’s also often used instead of “onde”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aonde você vai depois do trabalho?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Where are you going after work?

definitions.note: contraction of a + os, used before masculine plural nouns
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela foi aos Estados Unidos no ano passado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She went to the United States last year.

definitions.note: Present tense form of "apagar" (also used as the command "turn off/put out/erase!").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apaga a luz antes de dormir.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She turns off the light before sleeping.

definitions.note: Common with lights/screens: "luz apagada", "televisão apagada".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A luz está apagada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The light is off.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A foto ficou apagada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The photo turned out faded.

definitions.note: Often used for lights or screens.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As luzes estão apagadas.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The lights are off.

definitions.note: Used for things like messages, files, or text that have been removed.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As mensagens apagadas não podem ser recuperadas.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The deleted messages can’t be recovered.

definitions.note: Masculine form. Used for things like lights/devices that are not on; feminine is “apagada”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O celular está apagado desde ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The phone has been off since yesterday.

definitions.note: Third-person plural (they/you all) form of "apagar" in the present tense; often used for lights, devices, or fires.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles apagam as luzes antes de sair.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They turn off the lights before leaving.

definitions.note: Third-person plural (they/you all) form of "apagar" in the present tense; used for removing writing or digital content.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles apagam os arquivos antigos do computador.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They delete the old files from the computer.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estou apagando a luz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m turning off the light.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estou apagando a mensagem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m deleting the message.

definitions.note: Often used for fires.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Os bombeiros estão apagando o fogo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The firefighters are putting out the fire.

definitions.native: to turn off, to put out, to erase
definitions.note: Often used for turning off lights/electronics, putting out a fire, or erasing text/data.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Você pode apagar a luz, por favor?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you turn off the light, please?

definitions.note: Common in contexts like bills and invoices: “apagar a conta / a fatura”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso apagar a conta até amanhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need to pay the bill by tomorrow.

definitions.note: Past tense (pretérito perfeito) for “they/you (plural)” in European Portuguese.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles apagaram a luz antes de sair.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They turned off the light before leaving.

definitions.note: Past (pretérito perfeito) form; often used for switching off lights/electronics or for erasing/deleting something.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele apagou a luz antes de sair.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He turned off the light before leaving.

definitions.note: Common as an imperative (command), often with você implied.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Por favor, apague a luz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Please turn off the light.

definitions.note: Common as an imperative (command), e.g. for writing or data.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apague o que você escreveu no quadro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Erase what you wrote on the board.

definitions.native: I erased, I deleted, I turned off
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apaguei a luz antes de sair.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I turned off the light before leaving.

definitions.note: Present subjunctive (also used for commands to ‘you all’).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Por favor, apaguem as luzes quando saírem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Please turn off the lights when you leave.

definitions.note: Often used with the reflexive pronoun: “se apaixona (por alguém/algo)” = “falls in love (with someone/something)”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela se apaixona por ele rapidamente.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She falls in love with him quickly.

definitions.note: Used without “se”, it can take a direct object (someone who is charmed/enchanted).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O filme apaixona o público.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The movie makes the audience fall in love.

definitions.note: Feminine form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela está apaixonada pelo namorado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She is in love with her boyfriend.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele falou apaixonadamente sobre o projeto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He spoke passionately about the project.

definitions.note: feminine plural
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Elas estão apaixonadas pelo projeto novo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They are in love with the new project.

definitions.note: Often used with "por" to say who/what someone is in love with ("apaixonado por alguém").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele está apaixonado por ela.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is in love with her.

definitions.note: Often used with the verb "estar" (e.g., "estar apaixonado").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele está apaixonado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is in love.

definitions.note: Often used with "por" to mean "passionate about" something.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles são apaixonados por música.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They are passionate about music.

definitions.note: Often used reflexively: apaixonar-se (to fall in love).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aquela música conseguiu apaixonar todo mundo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: That song managed to make everyone fall in love.

definitions.native: they captivated, they made (someone) fall in love
definitions.note: Often used with a direct object (someone is captivated). To say “they fell in love,” Portuguese usually uses the reflexive form: “apaixonaram-se”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As músicas apaixonaram o público.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The songs captivated the audience.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu me apaixonei por ela no primeiro dia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I fell in love with her on the first day.

definitions.note: Simple past (pretérito perfeito) form, often used with "por" or "por alguém".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela se apaixonou por ele no primeiro dia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She fell in love with him on the first day.

definitions.note: Past participle of "apanhar"; often used with "ser/estar" to mean "caught".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O ladrão foi apanhado pela polícia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The thief was caught by the police.

definitions.note: Often used for someone who picks/collects things (for example, fruit).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O apanhador colheu maçãs no pomar de manhã cedo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The picker picked apples in the orchard early in the morning.

definitions.note: Masculine plural form (past participle), often used in the passive voice.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Os ladrões foram apanhados pela polícia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The thieves were caught by the police.

definitions.note: Often used for physically picking something up or retrieving it from a place.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou apanhar as chaves no chão.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to pick up the keys from the floor.

definitions.note: Used for catching something moving (like a ball) or capturing someone/something.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele conseguiu apanhar a bola no ar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He managed to catch the ball in midair.

definitions.native: to get hit; to take a beating (to be beaten up)
definitions.note: In everyday speech, "apanhar" can mean receiving physical punishment or being hit.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele vai apanhar se continuar a provocar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He’ll get hit if he keeps provoking.

definitions.native: to catch (a disease); to come down with
definitions.note: Common in Portuguese to mean catching an illness (e.g., a cold).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apanhou uma gripe forte no inverno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She caught a bad flu in the winter.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele apanhou as chaves do chão.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He picked up the keys from the floor.

definitions.note: Often used for catching something (like a cold) or catching public transport (e.g., a bus).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apanhou um resfriado na semana passada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She caught a cold last week.

definitions.note: Informal (Brazilian) spelling/pronunciation of “apanhar” with the final -r dropped, common in speech, lyrics, and casual writing.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou apanhá o ônibus na esquina.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to catch the bus on the corner.

definitions.note: Often used for cutting off small parts to make something even or neat (e.g., hair, nails, hedges).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso aparar as pontas do meu cabelo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need to trim the ends of my hair.

definitions.note: Present tense form of "aparecer" (also used for "you" (você) and "he/she/it").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aparece sempre na hora errada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He always shows up at the wrong time.

definitions.note: Present tense (they/you all) of "aparecer".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As estrelas aparecem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The stars appear at night.

definitions.note: Gerund form of “aparecer” (used like “-ing” in English).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele está aparecendo em todas as reuniões.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is showing up at every meeting.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele vai aparecer na festa mais tarde.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He’s going to show up at the party later.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles apareceram de repente na festa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They suddenly appeared at the party.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aparecerá amanhã de manhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He will show up tomorrow morning.

definitions.note: Imperfect subjunctive of "aparecer" (often used after expressions like "if" or "I wanted" to talk about a hypothetical situation in the past).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Se ele aparecesse amanhã, eu ficaria muito feliz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: If he appeared tomorrow, I would be very happy.

definitions.note: Simple past (pretérito perfeito) of “aparecer” (often used for a sudden or completed appearance).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele apareceu de repente na porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He suddenly appeared at the door.

definitions.note: Imperfect past tense (used for ongoing/repeated past actions or background description).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela aparecia todos os dias na mesma hora.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She appeared every day at the same time.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Este aparelho não está funcionando.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This device isn't working.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela usa aparelho nos dentes.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She wears braces on her teeth.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aparenta estar cansado hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He seems to be tired today.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aparentemente, ele já saiu.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Apparently, he already left.

definitions.note: Present subjunctive (also used for affirmative commands with você).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Espero que você apareça amanhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I hope you show up tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aparou a cerca viva no sábado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He trimmed the hedge on Saturday.

definitions.note: Often used for stopping or intercepting something in motion (like a ball).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O goleiro aparou a bola com as duas mãos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The goalkeeper caught the ball with both hands.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu moro em um apartamento pequeno no centro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I live in a small apartment downtown.

definitions.note: plural
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles alugaram dois apartamentos no centro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They rented two apartments downtown.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A aparência dele mudou muito nos últimos anos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: His appearance has changed a lot in recent years.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As aparências enganam.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Appearances can be deceiving.

definitions.note: Often implies being extremely frightened or in a panic.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu fiquei apavorado quando ouvi aquele barulho.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I was terrified when I heard that noise.

definitions.note: Often used with prepositions: apelar para (appeal to) / apelar a (appeal to).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles vão apelar para a decisão do juiz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They are going to appeal the judge’s decision.

definitions.note: Commonly used when someone uses a last option, often something negative (e.g., violence, insults).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele vai apelar à violência quando ficar sem argumentos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He will resort to violence when he runs out of arguments.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O apelido dele na escola era "Panda".
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: His nickname at school was "Panda".

definitions.note: Often interchangeable with só; apenas can sound a bit more formal or emphatic.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: São apenas dez minutos daqui.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It's only ten minutes from here.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Depois da corrida, eu apenas conseguia respirar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: After the run, I could barely breathe.

definitions.note: Often refers to a pre-meal drink or small snack served before a meal.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vamos tomar um aperitivo antes do jantar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Let's have an aperitif before dinner.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vamos pedir alguns aperitivos antes do jantar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Let’s order some appetizers before dinner.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aperta o botão para ligar a máquina.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He presses the button to turn on the machine.

definitions.note: Often used for clothes that feel too small, or for spaces that feel cramped/narrow.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Esta blusa está apertada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This blouse is tight.

definitions.note: Often used for clothes/shoes that feel too small or spaces that are narrow/crowded.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Este sapato está apertado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This shoe is tight.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Você pode apertar este parafuso com a chave?
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Can you tighten this screw with the wrench?

definitions.note: Also used as a polite command (imperative) meaning “press/tighten!”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aperte o botão para ligar a máquina.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Press the button to turn on the machine.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apertei o botão errado e a máquina parou.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I pressed the wrong button and the machine stopped.

definitions.note: This is a present subjunctive (or affirmative command) form used with vocês (you all).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Por favor, apertem os cintos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Please fasten your seat belts.

definitions.note: Common in expressions like "passar um aperto" (to go through a hard time).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Passei um aperto no trabalho hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I had a rough time at work today.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele me deu um aperto no braço.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He gave my arm a squeeze.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele apertou o parafuso com a chave.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He tightened the screw with the wrench.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apertou o botão para ligar a luz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She pressed the button to turn on the light.

definitions.note: Most commonly used in the fixed phrase “apesar de”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apesar da chuva, fomos ao parque.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Despite the rain, we went to the park.

definitions.note: Most often used in the expression “apesar de” + noun/infinitive (“despite …”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apesar do frio, fomos à praia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Despite the cold, we went to the beach.

definitions.note: Usually used as "apesar de" + noun or infinitive ("despite.../in spite of...").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Apesar da chuva, fomos ao parque.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Despite the rain, we went to the park.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estou sem apetite hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I have no appetite today.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A sopa está bem apimentada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The soup is very spicy.

definitions.note: Often used figuratively for stories, jokes, or comments with sexual or provocative content.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela contou uma história apimentada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She told a racy story.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O público começou a aplaudir no final do show.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The audience started to applaud at the end of the show.

definitions.note: Simple past (pretérito perfeito): “they” or “you (plural)” (European Portuguese) applauded.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Todos aplaudiram no final do espetáculo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Everyone applauded at the end of the show.

definitions.note: Simple past (pretérito perfeito) form of “aplaudir” (he/she/it/you formal applauded).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O público aplaudiu no final do concerto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The audience applauded at the end of the concert.

definitions.note: Plural form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O cantor recebeu muitos aplausos no final do show.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The singer received a lot of applause at the end of the show.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela aplica essa regra em todos os projetos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She applies this rule in all the projects.

definitions.note: Often used for applying for a job/course (“aplicar para/ a”) or applying something (a rule, a product) (“aplicar em/ sobre”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou aplicar para esse emprego amanhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to apply for that job tomorrow.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu baixei um aplicativo para aprender português.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I downloaded an app to learn Portuguese.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aplique o creme na pele duas vezes por dia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Apply the cream to your skin twice a day.

definitions.note: Present participle/gerund form, used to describe an ongoing process.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A fruta está apodrecendo na fruteira.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The fruit is rotting in the fruit bowl.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As frutas vão apodrecer se você não colocar na geladeira.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The fruit will rot if you don't put it in the fridge.

definitions.note: Present tense form of "apoiar".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apoia o projeto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She supports the project.

definitions.note: Can also mean “we lean (something) against” in some contexts, but “we support” is the most common meaning.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Nós apoiamos o seu projeto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We support your project.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu vou apoiar você na entrevista.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to support you in the interview.

definitions.note: Often used with "em": "apoiar em" = "to lean on".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Para descansar, ela precisou apoiar em a parede.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: To rest, she needed to lean on the wall.

definitions.note: From the verb “apoiar” (to support).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu apoio essa ideia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I support that idea.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Obrigado pelo seu apoio durante esse projeto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Thank you for your support during that project.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela apoiou a ideia desde o início.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She supported the idea from the beginning.

definitions.note: Informal/spoken spelling of “apoiar” (common in casual Brazilian Portuguese).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Pode contar comigo: eu vou te apoiá.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: You can count on me: I’m going to support you.

definitions.note: Can mean pointing something out (physically) or indicating/showing something more generally.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela aponta para o mapa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She points to the map.

definitions.note: Often used with “para” (pointing to/at).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele está apontando para o mapa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is pointing at the map.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu vou apontar para a porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to point to the door.

definitions.note: Used as a command (imperative) or in the present subjunctive of "apontar."
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Aponte no mapa onde fica Lisboa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Point on the map where Lisbon is.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele apontou para a porta e disse: “É ali.”
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He pointed at the door and said, “It’s there.”

definitions.note: feminine form (used for a woman or a feminine noun)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Minha avó está aposentada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My grandmother is retired.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Meu avô é aposentado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My grandfather is retired.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Minha mãe vai se aposentar no fim do ano, e a aposentadoria dela começa em janeiro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My mom is going to retire at the end of the year, and her retirement starts in January.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela quer aposentar aos 60 anos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She wants to retire at 60.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu me aposentei no ano passado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I retired last year.

definitions.note: Somewhat formal/literary; often used in the plural (aposentos) meaning “quarters.”

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I'm going to tidy up my room now.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso arrumar os documentos antes da reunião.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need to organize the documents before the meeting.

definitions.note: Often used as a command (imperative for você) or in the present subjunctive (e.g., after que).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Arrume seu quarto, por favor.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Tidy up your room, please.

definitions.native: I tidied up, I organized, I fixed
definitions.note: Past tense (eu): used for something you did and finished.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu arrumei meu quarto ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I tidied up my room last night.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu arrumo o meu quarto todos os sábados.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I tidy up my room every Saturday.

definitions.note: Common in Brazil for solving a problem (e.g., fixing a situation or getting something arranged).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Calma, eu arrumo isso depois.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Don’t worry, I’ll fix that later.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela arrumou o quarto antes de sair.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She tidied up the room before leaving.

definitions.note: Often used in Brazil for fixing something that isn’t working (a device, a problem, etc.).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele arrumou o computador ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He fixed the computer yesterday.

definitions.note: Informal/colloquial spelling (common in Brazilian Portuguese) representing the infinitive "arrumar" with the final -r dropped in speech.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou arrumá a casa antes da visita.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to tidy up the house before the visit.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A arte faz parte da nossa cultura.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Art is part of our culture.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O museu exibiu artefatos antigos da região.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The museum displayed ancient artifacts from the region.

definitions.note: Plural of "arte".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela estuda artes na universidade.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She studies arts at the university.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Este pão é artesanal e muito fresco.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: This bread is handmade and very fresh.

definitions.note: Often used for things with moving joints (e.g., a toy) or for speech/ideas that are clearly organized and expressed.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele fez um discurso articulado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He gave an articulated, well-structured speech.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estas flores são artificiais.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: These flowers are artificial.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As flores são artificial, mas parecem reais.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The flowers are artificial, but they look real.

definitions.note: Commonly used for a newspaper/magazine/online article; also used for an academic paper or a legal article (a section of a law).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Li um artigo interessante sobre viagens.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I read an interesting article about travel.

definitions.note: Plural of "artigo".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu comprei dois artigos na loja.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I bought two items at the store.

definitions.note: Often used for products or entries in a list; plural of "artigo".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A lista tem dez artigos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The list has ten items.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A artilharia começou a disparar ao amanhecer.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The artillery started firing at dawn.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A minha irmã é artista e pinta quadros lindos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My sister is an artist and paints beautiful paintings.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Os artistas chegaram cedo para o ensaio.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The artists arrived early for the rehearsal.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O médico explicou que a artéria estava bloqueada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The doctor explained that the artery was blocked.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O projeto tem um valor artístico enorme.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The project has enormous artistic value.

definitions.note: feminine plural definite article; used before feminine plural nouns
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As meninas estão na escola.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The girls are at school.

definitions.note: Often written with an accent as “às” (contraction of “a” + “as”).

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I'm going to the (female/plural) stores tomorrow.

definitions.note: used with feminine plural nouns
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As meninas estão na escola.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The girls are at school.

definitions.note: feminine plural direct object pronoun
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu as vi ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I saw them yesterday.

definitions.note: used before feminine plural nouns
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As meninas estão na escola.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The girls are at school.

definitions.note: feminine plural direct object pronoun
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu as vi ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I saw them yesterday.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O pássaro machucou a asa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The bird hurt its wing.

definitions.note: Plural of "asa".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O pássaro abriu as asas e voou.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The bird opened its wings and flew.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A rua está coberta de asfalto novo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The street is covered with new asphalt.

definitions.note: Often used in the context of seeking protection (e.g., political asylum).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele pediu asilo no país vizinho.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He asked for asylum in the neighboring country.

definitions.note: In Portuguese, "asilo" can refer to a home for elderly people.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A minha avó mora num asilo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My grandmother lives in a nursing home.

definitions.native: (likely) assim: like this, like that, so

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Não é asim que se faz.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: That’s not how you do it.

definitions.note: Plural masculine form; used for a group of men or a mixed group.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Os turistas asiáticos chegaram ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The Asian tourists arrived yesterday.

definitions.note: plural masculine form; can refer to a mixed-gender group
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Há muitos asiáticos nesta cidade.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: There are many Asians in this city.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele tem asma desde criança.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He has asthma since he was a child.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O aspecto da casa mudou depois da reforma.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The appearance of the house changed after the renovation.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vamos analisar os principais aspectos do projeto.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We’re going to analyze the main aspects of the project.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela aspira fundo antes de falar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She inhales deeply before speaking.

definitions.note: Often used with a direct object (e.g., “aspira a casa” = vacuums the house).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele aspira o tapete todos os sábados.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He vacuums the carpet every Saturday.

definitions.note: Used with “a” + noun/infinitive (e.g., “aspira a uma promoção” = aspires to a promotion).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela aspira a uma promoção este ano.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She aspires to a promotion this year.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela tem grandes aspirações para o futuro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She has big aspirations for the future.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Tomei uma aspirina para a dor de cabeça.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I took an aspirin for my headache.

definitions.note: feminine singular form (used to agree with a feminine noun)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Quero uma batata assada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I want a baked potato.

definitions.note: Used mainly to describe food (especially meat) cooked in the oven or over heat.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O frango está assado e pronto para servir.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The chicken is roasted and ready to serve.

definitions.note: Past participle (feminine singular) of "assaltar"; commonly used to mean being robbed (often in the street). Often confused with English "assaulted."
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela foi assaltada ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She was mugged last night.

definitions.note: Often used to talk about someone being robbed on the street (mugged).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele foi assaltado ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He was mugged last night.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia prendeu o assaltante.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police arrested the robber.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia prendeu dois assaltantes depois do roubo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police arrested two robbers after the robbery.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dois homens assaltaram o banco ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Two men robbed the bank yesterday.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Houve um assalto na esquina ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: There was a robbery on the corner last night.

definitions.note: Present participle/gerund of "assar" (used like English “-ing”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estou assando frango para o jantar.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m roasting chicken for dinner.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou assar frango no forno.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m going to roast chicken in the oven.

definitions.note: Feminine form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A assassina foi presa pela polícia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The murderer was arrested by the police.

definitions.note: Feminine singular past participle of "assassinar"; used with "ser" for passive voice or with "ter/haver" in compound tenses.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A jornalista foi assassinada ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The journalist was murdered last night.

definitions.note: Past participle of "assassinar"; often used with "ser" (e.g., "foi assassinado").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O jornalista foi assassinado ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The journalist was murdered last night.

definitions.note: past participle (masculine plural)
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Os jornalistas foram assassinados durante a guerra.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The journalists were murdered during the war.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia disse que ele planejava assassinar o prefeito.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police said he was planning to assassinate the mayor.

definitions.note: Simple past (they) form.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles assassinaram o rei.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They murdered the king.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia está investigando o assassinato.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police are investigating the murder.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia investiga vários assassinatos na cidade.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police are investigating several murders in the city.

definitions.note: Noun. Refers to a person who kills someone deliberately.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O assassino foi preso pela polícia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The murderer was arrested by the police.

definitions.note: Adjective. Can describe something extremely harmful or fatal (more common in feminine/plural forms depending on the noun, but here kept with the exact form requested).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O vírus assassino se espalhou rapidamente.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The deadly virus spread quickly.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia prendeu o assassino.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police arrested the killer.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A polícia prendeu dois assassinos ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The police arrested two murderers last night.

definitions.note: Simple past (pretérito perfeito) of "assassinar".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele assassinou o homem na rua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He killed the man in the street.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Vou assegurar que tudo esteja pronto a tempo.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’ll make sure everything is ready on time.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela tentou assegurar o filho de que estava tudo bem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She tried to reassure her son that everything was fine.

definitions.note: Present subjunctive (also used for affirmative formal commands: você).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: É importante que você assegure que todos entendam as regras.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: It’s important that you make sure everyone understands the rules.

definitions.note: Present tense (eu). Often used to emphasize certainty or to promise something is true.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu asseguro que vou ligar amanhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I assure you that I’ll call tomorrow.

definitions.note: Often used with "a" (e.g., "assemelhar-se a...").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O filho assemelha-se ao pai.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The son resembles his father.

definitions.note: Often used with a reflexive pronoun: “assenta-se” = “sits down.”
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele assenta-se no sofá.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He sits down on the couch.

definitions.note: Common in contexts like placing bricks/tiles or setting something firmly in position.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O pedreiro assenta os tijolos com cuidado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The bricklayer sets the bricks carefully.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Meu assento é na janela.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: My seat is by the window.

definitions.note: Often used for official records (e.g., "assento de nascimento" = birth record).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso do assento de nascimento para fazer o documento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need the birth record to get the document done.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ainda há assentos disponíveis nesta fila.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: There are still seats available in this row.

definitions.note: Often used for the saddle seat in horseback riding contexts.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O cavalo tem assentos confortáveis.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The horse has comfortable saddle seats.

definitions.note: Often used for someone who advises or assists an important person (e.g., in government or a company).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele é assessor do ministro.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He is the minister's advisor.

definitions.note: can also mean 'like that' or 'so' depending on context
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Faça assim para abrir a porta.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do it this way to open the door.

definitions.note: Often used to explain or clarify something (similar to “like this/that”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Faça assim: primeiro abra o e-mail e depois clique no link.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Do it like this: first open the email and then click the link.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela assina o contrato hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She signs the contract today.

definitions.note: Past participle of "assinar"; often used like an adjective (e.g., "contrato assinado").
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O contrato já está assinado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The contract is already signed.

definitions.note: Often used for signing documents, forms, or agreements.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Você precisa assinar este documento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: You need to sign this document.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles assinaram o contrato ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They signed the contract yesterday.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso da sua assinatura neste documento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need your signature on this document.

definitions.note: Commonly used for recurring services (magazines, streaming, etc.).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Cancelei a assinatura do serviço de streaming.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I canceled my subscription to the streaming service.

definitions.note: Plural of "assinatura".
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso de duas assinaturas neste documento.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need two signatures on this document.

definitions.note: Common in contexts like streaming services, newspapers, or software; plural.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: As assinaturas do aplicativo são mensais.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The app subscriptions are monthly.

definitions.note: Often used as a formal command or request (e.g., on forms or letters).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Por favor, assine aqui.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Please sign here.

definitions.note: Past tense (pretérito perfeito), 1st person singular.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assinei o contrato ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I signed the contract yesterday.

definitions.note: Present tense (eu).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assino o contrato hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I sign the contract today.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela assinou o contrato ontem.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She signed the contract yesterday.

definitions.note: Informal/colloquial spelling (common in Brazil) that reflects dropping the final -r of the infinitive “assinar”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Preciso assiná este documento hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need to sign this document today.

definitions.note: Often used as a command (imperative) meaning “watch” (as in watch TV/a movie). It can also be the present subjunctive form of “assistir”. Although it looks like English “assist”, it usually does NOT mean “help” in Portuguese.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Assista ao filme até o fim.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Watch the movie until the end.

definitions.note: Often used with the preposition “a” (e.g., “assistir a algo”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele assiste à televisão todas as noites.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He watches TV every night.

definitions.note: Often used with the preposition “a” (e.g., “assistir a algo”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela assiste à aula de português hoje.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She attends the Portuguese class today.

definitions.note: Third-person plural present tense of "assistir"; with "a" it often means "attend" (e.g., assistir a uma aula).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles assistem ao jogo todos os domingos.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They watch the game every Sunday.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela é professora assistente na universidade.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She is an assistant professor at the university.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A assistente organizou os documentos para a reunião.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The assistant organized the documents for the meeting.

definitions.note: Common in contexts like events or classes, meaning a person who is present.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Havia mais de cem assistentes na palestra.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: There were more than a hundred attendees at the talk.

definitions.note: Often used for watching TV, movies, videos, etc. (can be a false friend with English “assist”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ontem eu assisti a um filme em casa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Yesterday I watched a movie at home.

definitions.note: Used for being present at an event (can be a false friend with English “assist”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assisti à palestra na universidade.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I attended the lecture at the university.

definitions.note: Often used with the preposition “a”: “assistir a (algo)” = to watch/attend (e.g., a movie, a class).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assistia à televisão todas as noites.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I used to watch TV every night.

definitions.note: More formal; often used with “a” for the person receiving help: “assistir a (alguém)”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O médico assistia aos pacientes no hospital.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The doctor was assisting the patients at the hospital.

definitions.note: Often used with movies, shows, videos, etc. (from "assistir" = to watch).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O filme foi assistido por milhares de pessoas.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The movie was watched by thousands of people.

definitions.note: Often used in formal contexts meaning someone received help/care (e.g., medical or social assistance).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: O paciente foi assistido por um médico.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The patient was assisted by a doctor.

definitions.note: Often used with "a" (assistir a) to mean "to watch/attend" (e.g., a um filme, a uma aula).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ontem assistimos a um filme em casa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Yesterday we watched a movie at home.

definitions.note: Often used with the preposition “a” (e.g., “assistindo a um filme”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Estou assistindo a um filme agora.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I’m watching a movie now.

definitions.note: Often used with the preposition “a” (e.g., “assistindo a uma aula”).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela está assistindo à aula de português.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She is attending the Portuguese class.

definitions.note: Commonly used with “a” before what you watch: “assistir a + [show/movie]”.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu gosto de assistir a filmes em casa.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I like to watch movies at home.

definitions.note: Usually used with "a" (assistir a) in European Portuguese; in Brazilian Portuguese it's also common without the preposition in everyday speech.
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eles assistiram ao filme ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They watched the movie last night.

definitions.note: Often used with a preposition: assistir a + something (e.g., assistir ao filme).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele assistiu ao jogo ontem à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He watched the game last night.

definitions.note: Often used with a preposition: assistir a + event/class (e.g., assistir à aula).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela assistiu à reunião de manhã.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She attended the meeting in the morning.

definitions.note: Usually used with the preposition “a”: “assisto a …” (e.g., a TV, a movie).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assisto à TV à noite.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I watch TV at night.

definitions.note: Usually used with the preposition “a”: “assisto a …” (e.g., a class, a meeting).
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Eu assisto à aula todos os dias.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I attend the class every day.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Obrigado pela sua assistência durante a mudança.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: Thank you for your help during the move.

definitions.note: Often used in fixed phrases like "assistência técnica" (technical support/service).

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I need to call my computer’s technical support/service.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele sabe assobiar muito bem.

definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I heard a whistle coming from the street.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ouvi assobios vindo da rua.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I heard whistles coming from the street.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ele assobiou uma música enquanto caminhava.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: He whistled a tune while he was walking.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Nós associamos esta música ao verão.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: We associate this song with summer.

definitions.note: often used for places (house, room) with a spooky/ghostly sense
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: A casa velha está assombrada.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: The old house is haunted.

definitions.note: used about a person (feminine) who is very frightened or startled
definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Ela ficou assombrada com o barulho.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: She was scared by the noise.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Dizem que este castelo é assombrado.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: They say this castle is haunted.

definitions.example_sentence_target_language: Fiquei assombrado com a notícia.
definitions.example_sentence_native_language: I was astonished by the news.
